title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Conveyancing Assistant / Legal Secretary

Location: North Norfolk
Salary: Competitive DOE + Excellent Benefits
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

An Exciting Opportunity Within a Well-Established Law Firm

We are delighted to be representing a highly regarded and successful law firm in their search for a Conveyancing Assistant / Legal Secretary to join their growing Residential Property team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an organised and proactive individual who is looking to develop their career within the legal sector. Whether you already have experience supporting conveyancers or have a strong administrative background within a professional services environment, our client is keen to hear from you.

Working as part of a friendly and supportive team, you will play a key role in assisting fee earners with a busy caseload of residential conveyancing matters from instruction through to completion.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Assistant / Legal Secretary, your duties will include:
- Providing comprehensive administrative support to Conveyancers and Solicitors
- Opening and closing client files in accordance with regulatory requirements
- Preparing legal documents, contracts, completion statements and correspondence
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, mortgage lenders and third parties
- Managing diaries, appointments and meeting arrangements
- Handling telephone and email enquiries professionally and efficiently
- Ordering searches and obtaining property-related documentation
- Assisting with exchange and completion processes
- Maintaining accurate case management system records
- Supporting with Land Registry applications and post-completion administration
- Ensuring all work is completed in line with firm procedures and compliance standards

About You

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience as a Conveyancing Assistant, Legal Secretary, Legal Administrator or similar support role
- Experience within residential conveyancing would be highly desirable
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
- A professional and client-focused approach
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office and case management systems
- The ability to prioritise a busy workload and work effectively within a team environment

What's On Offer?
- Competitive salary dependent on experience
- Friendly and supportive working environment
- Opportunities for training and career progression
- Generous holiday allowance
- Pension scheme
- Modern offices and excellent facilities
- The opportunity to join a respected and growing law firm

Interested?

If you are a motivated and organised individual looking to build upon your legal support experience within a reputable law firm, we would love to hear from you.

Interested?

Please call Michelle Topley on or email your CV to . Alternatively apply online.

title: In-house Paralegal
description:
Join Our Dynamic In-House Legal Team!

Are you a detail-oriented Paralegal with a passion for contract law and a desire to work in a fast-paced, innovative environment? Anglian is seeking a motivated and experienced In-House Paralegal to support our growing legal department with debt recovery and dispute resolution. This is a unique opportunity to be an integral part of a national multi branded company.

Key Responsibilities:
- Legal Research & Analysis: Conduct thorough legal research on issues related to corporate governance, compliance, and contract law to support our legal team.
- Drafting & Reviewing Documents: Assist in drafting, reviewing, and revising a wide range of legal documents, including contracts, agreements, and corporate policies.
- Case Management: Manage case files, track deadlines, and ensure compliance with all filing and reporting requirements.
- Corporate Records Maintenance: Maintain and update corporate records, including minutes, resolutions, and filings with regulatory bodies.
- Contract Management: Support contract lifecycle management by organising and maintaining contract databases, tracking key dates, and ensuring adherence to contract terms.
- Compliance Support: Assist with the implementation and monitoring of compliance programs to ensure adherence to internal policies and regulatory requirements.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with various departments such as HR, Finance, and Operations to provide legal support and ensure alignment with corporate objectives.

Qualifications:
- Experience: Minimum of 2-4 years of experience as a Paralegal in a corporate or in-house setting.
- Education: Bachelor's degree and/or Paralegal Certification.
- Skills: Strong understanding of corporate law, contract law, and compliance. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Proficient in legal research tools and contract management systems.
- Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organisation.

Why Join Us?
- Competitive Salary
- 31 days holiday, increasing to 33 days after 2 years of service plus have your birthday off
- Pension
- Paid time off annually to volunteer
- Comprehensive health & well-being benefits including cycle to work scheme, 24hr remote access to a doctor, heavily discounted gym memberships and free access to mental health first aiders
- Heavily discounted group discount scheme on all products
- Group Perks and freebies on days out, cinema, theatre, eating in and out, mobiles phones, a new car, food shopping and most major high street retailers
- Opportunity to work with a forward-thinking and supportive team.
- Career development and continuous learning opportunities.

Our Company is committed to monitoring & aligning its Policies with up-to-date Government guidance on reducing the spread of respiratory infections in the workplace. Through the Company's value of "Succeed Together" we are committed to Equality, Diversity and Inclusion. We recruit the 'best person for the job' regardless of any protected characteristics as defined by the Equality Act 2010 creating an inclusive working environment and culture for our employees.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Legal Secretary - Litigation

Dereham, Norfolk

- Competitive salary dependent on experience

- Opportunity to work for a reputable local law firm
- Long-term career development opportunities
- Generous holiday entitlement and additional benefits

If you are an experienced Legal Secretary looking to join a welcoming and professional firm in Dereham, we would love to hear from you.

title: paralegal
description:
Job Title: Paralegal

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated, organised and detail-oriented Paralegal to join a legal team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous legal experience who is looking to develop their skills and progress their career within a professional legal environment.

The successful candidate will provide legal and administrative support to solicitors and fee earners, assisting with case management, legal documentation, client communication and the day-to-day running of legal matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting solicitors and fee earners with the management and progression of legal cases.
- Preparing, drafting and reviewing legal documents and correspondence.
- Conducting legal research and summarising findings where required.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client files and case management records.
- Liaising with clients, courts, counsel, third parties and other relevant organisations.
- Preparing bundles, schedules and supporting documentation.
- Monitoring deadlines and ensuring documents are completed and submitted on time.
- Supporting case preparation and ensuring compliance with relevant procedures.
- Providing general administrative support to the legal team.
- Maintaining confidentiality and delivering a professional standard of client care.

Requirements
- Previous experience working within a legal environment is desirable, with experience requirements depending on the level of the role.
- A law degree, LPC, SQE-related qualification or relevant legal experience would be advantageous.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- A professional and client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good IT skills and familiarity with legal case management systems would be beneficial.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be proactive, reliable and enthusiastic about developing their legal career. They will have a strong work ethic, a willingness to learn and the ability to support a busy legal team effectively.

How to Apply

If you have the relevant skills and experience and are interested in developing your career within the legal sector, we would welcome your application.
